title: Raid night tools
text:
Ready checks, pull timers, quest sharing and a home of your choice.

✨ Ready check: group leaders type /ready (or press Ready check in the Party window), and every member answers Ready or Not ready
✨ Pull timer: /pull 10 shows a big countdown on everyone's screen
✨ Share quests with your group from the quest log (Share button) or with /share
✨ Choose your home: talk to Quartermaster Ilsa at Emberwatch or Jarl Hakon in Frostpeak to make it your home, and your hearth takes you there. Captain Oriel sets it back to Hearthmere
⬆️ The Sunken Vault stays a dungeon for up to 5 heroes. Raid groups need to split into parties to enter it
🔧 Fixed an error that could spam during big boss fights when a name label could not be placed on screen
